sampling_bias: 20m original has unweighted norm; SSP_TRAPZ separately isolates endpoint weighting before dense sampling
metric_e_sign: reference is second vector, FD in FE-vs-FD; raw archived values, sign selection only
metric_e_complex: reference target norm is first vector; alpha minimizes weighted residual; diagnostic only
same_method_cross_grid_metric_names: In generic metric fields FE_* means first/coarse vector and FD_* means second/fine reference, BOTH belong to method column. No FD961 vector is implied.
coupling: phi(source)*phi(receiver), no radial propagation factor or full-mode summation; no per-channel fitted gain
equal_depth_arrays: single-mode Q vectors at same receiver depth are collinear by construction; nearzero shape errors are a structural control, not full-field accuracy
weak_flags: fixed design flags, no realistic SNR inferred; raw finite ratios retained, exactly zero reference undefined
own_method_order: single cross-grid pair does not estimate individual-method convergence order
bias_classification_formula: abs(e_dense-e_20m)>max(2e-5,0.1*e_dense); reported relative increase uses e_20m denominator
check_counts: cold checks are reconstruction items, not independent physical experiments
